md:grid-cols-2 md:gap-x-10"><div><div class="hgw-intro text-fg text-sm leading-6 text-pretty"><p>Grok Bot is your AI teammate with a computer. Each Bot works in your apps and on
a computer in the cloud, so it keeps working while you&#x27;re away.</p><p>Bots can use other services through plugins and custom MCP servers. They can
also hand coding work to Cursor Cloud Agents and attach the results to their
reply.</p><p>This page explains how Grok Bot works by following one common request from
start to finish. Say you have a Bot for your travel and expenses, and you send
it this:</p></div><p class="font-display text-primary mt-6 text-lg leading-7 tracking-tight text-balance">“<!-- -->Sign me up for the same conference as last year and expense it.<!-- -->”</p></div><ol href="#1-it-checks-its-memory">1. It checks its memory</a></h2></span><p>Your message doesn&#x27;t say which conference, which pass, or which card to use.
Your expenses Bot fills in those details from memory. Its work log has last
year&#x27;s 2-day pass, and you gave it a rule to use the work card for conferences.
Ask what it used, and it shows you.</p><div data-fullscreen="none" class="not-prose my-6 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl outline-1 -outline-offset-1 outline-black/10 dark:outline-white/10"><div class="gbm-wide"><div role="group" aria-label="An expenses Bot listing what it remembers" class="gbm-frame tls hiw-story" data-camera="zoom"><span class="absolute inset-0 [&amp;_img]:size-full block dark:hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" role="presentation" style="object-fit:cover;width:100%" srcSet="https://media.x.ai/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,onerror=redirect,width=640,f=auto/v1/docs/grok-bot-wallpaper-light-violet-7x6-cb3d0b90.webp 640w,

short</dd></div><div><dt class="text-primary text-sm leading-6 font-medium">Work log</dt><dd class="text-primary/70 text-sm leading-6 text-pretty">Drafted your offsite agenda</dd></div></dl></div></div></figure><p>So you only have to say something once. Tell any Bot your time zone, and all
your Bots know it. Tell your expenses Bot where receipts go, and only that Bot
knows it.</p><p>A Bot decides on its own what to remember. You can also ask it to remember
something, fix it, or forget it. Memories can go out of date, so for numbers
that change, like prices, ask the Bot to look them up again. Keep logins and
cards out of memory and in <a href="/grok-bot/vault" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Vault</a>. See
<a href="/grok-bot/bots#what-a-bot-remembers" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">What a Bot remembers</a>.</p><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="2-it-finds-last-years-receipt-in-gmail" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#2-it-finds-last-years-receipt-in-gmail">2. It finds last year&#x27;s receipt in Gmail</a></h2></span><p>Next, the Bot searches Gmail for last year&#x27;s receipt. Gmail is a connected app,
so the Bot works in it directly instead of opening the website. That&#x27;s more
reliable than clicking through pages in a browser.</p><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="add-your-own-tools" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#add-your-own-tools">Add your own tools</a></h3></span><p>If an app isn&#x27;t in the catalog, ask a Bot to connect the app&#x27;s MCP server, the
standard way AI tools connect to a service. If the service has an API but no MCP
server, <a href="https://x.ai/bot/marketplace/bots/tinkabot" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">tinkabot</a> can build one. It
wraps the API in a plugin with an MCP server and skills, tests it, and publishes
it only when you say so. See
<a href="/grok-bot/computer-and-apps#connect-an-app" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Connect an app</a>.</p><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="3-it-signs-in-and-buys-the-pass" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#3-it-signs-in-and-buys-the-pass">3. It signs in and buys the pass</a></h2></span><p>The conference site has no app, so the Bot opens it in a browser on its cloud
computer. All your Bots share that computer. It also has a command line and
files that stay between tasks. Each Bot gets its own screen, so several Bots can
work at once, and you can watch any screen live. When one Bot signs in to a
site, your other Bots are signed in too.</p><p>The site asks for a password. The Bot looks for a login in this order:</p><figure class="not-prose my-8" aria-label="Where a Bot looks for a login, in order"><ol class="flex flex-col gap-3"><li class="hgw-box hgw-signin"><span </span>you@example.com</span><span class="baby-grok-bot-choice-input"><span class="sr-only">Password: hidden</span><span aria-hidden="true">•••••••••••••••••••</span></span><label class="hiw-check baby-grok-bot-card-secondary"><input type="checkbox" checked=""/>Securely save to Bot&#x27;s vault</label><div class="flex items-center gap-3"><p class="baby-grok-bot-card-secondary min-w-0 flex-1">Never shown to your Bot. Filled directly to tickets.example.com.</p><button class="baby-grok-bot-card-action" data-variant="primary" type="button">Submit</button></div></div></div></div><div aria-live="polite"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><p>Whichever one it uses, the login goes straight into the page, and your Bot never
sees it.</p><p>To pay, the Bot uses the work card you saved in Vault. A saved card fills in at
checkout without asking you each time, and the Bot never sees the number. If
you&#x27;d rather approve every payment, don&#x27;t save the card. See
<a href="/grok-bot/vault#pay-for-things" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Pay for things</a>.</p><p>If a task needs an API key, the Bot sends you a secure secret card. The key
stays hidden and out of the chat.</p><p>Some steps need you, like single sign-on, a passkey, or a CAPTCHA the Bot can&#x27;t
solve. For those, the Bot hands you the computer. Choose <strong>Open computer</strong> on
the request, then <strong>Take control</strong>. Finish that step, and tell the Bot to
continue. See <a href="/grok-bot/vault" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Vault and secure sign-in</a> and
<a href="/grok-bot/computer-and-apps#connect-1password" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Connect 1Password</a>.</p><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="4-it-asks-before-it-emails-finance" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#4-it-asks-before-it-emails-finance">4. It asks before it emails finance</a></h2></span><p>With the pass bought, the Bot is ready to email the receipt to finance. You made
a rule to approve emails first, so it stops and asks you.</p><div data-fullscreen="none" class="not-prose my-6 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl outline-1 -outline-offset-1 outline-black/10 dark:outline-white/10"><div class="gbm-wide"><div role="group" aria-label="An Ask first card for emailing a receipt to finance" class="gbm-frame hiw" data-camera="zoom"><span class="absolute inset-0 [&amp;_img]:size-full block dark:hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" role="presentation" style="object-fit:cover;width:100%" srcSet="https://media.x.ai/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,onerror=redirect,width=640,f=auto/v1/docs/grok-bot-wallpaper-light-blue-7x6-704072c3.webp 640w,

Your rule says to ask before I send an email.</span></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="baby-grok-bot-entry-enter hiw-card mt-2"><div class="baby-grok-bot-card"><p class="baby-grok-bot-card-title">Email the receipt to finance</p><p class="baby-grok-bot-card-secondary mt-0.5">Paused by your Ask first rule</p><div class="mt-2 outline-none"><dl class="baby-grok-bot-message-panel hiw-panel"><div class="baby-grok-bot-message-row"><dt>To</dt><dd>finance@example.com</dd></div><div class="baby-grok-bot-message-row"><dt>Subject</dt><dd>2-day pass receipt, $749</dd></div></dl></div><div class="hiw-actions mt-2.5"><button class="baby-grok-bot-card-action hiw-edit-rule" data-variant="ghost" type="button">Edit rule</button><button class="baby-grok-bot-card-action" data-variant="secondary" type="button">Not now</button><button class="baby-grok-bot-card-action" data-variant="primary" type="button">Allow</button></div></div></div><div aria-live="polite"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><p>Before a Bot runs a command, uses an app, or acts on its computer, Auto Review
checks the action. Auto Review is on by default, and most actions go ahead on
their own. When one needs you, the Bot shows an approval card with the action
and its details, then waits.</p><p>You can add your own rules too. In <strong>Settings → General</strong>, under <strong>Bot</strong>, open
<strong>Custom Rules</strong>. Describe an action in plain words, like “send an email,” and
choose <strong>Ask first</strong> or <strong>Allow automatically</strong>. An <strong>Ask first</strong> rule always
stops a matching action. That&#x27;s the rule that stopped this email.</p><p>A card stopped by an <strong>Ask first</strong> rule shows <strong>Edit rule</strong>, which opens your
Custom Rules. Other cards can show <strong>Always allow</strong>, which saves a rule so
similar actions run on their own next time.</p><p>Only your own messages count as instructions. Say the conference page had hidden
text telling the Bot to email your contacts. Auto Review wouldn&#x27;t treat that as
a request from you. These checks lower the risk from harmful content, but they
don&#x27;t remove it. Keep <strong>Ask first</strong> rules on anything you can&#x27;t undo. See
<a href="/grok-bot/approvals-security-and-privacy#configure-auto-review" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Configure Auto Review</a>.</p><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="5-it-logs-the-expense-and-reports-back" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#5-it-logs-the-expense-and-reports-back">5. It logs the expense and reports back</a></h2></span><p>Last, the Bot adds the expense to your Finance sheet in Google Drive, another
connected app. Then it replies with everything it did. If you&#x27;ve closed your
laptop by then, it keeps going and notifies you when it&#x27;s done.</p><p>The chat shows each step as the Bot works, from your message to its reply.</p><div data-fullscreen="none" class="not-prose my-6 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl outline-1 -outline-offset-1 outline-black/10 dark:outline-white/10"><div class="gbm-wide"><div role="group" aria-label="An expenses Bot registering you for a conference and logging the expense" class="gbm-frame tls hiw-story" data-camera="zoom"><span class="absolute inset-0 [&amp;_img]:size-full block dark:hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" role="presentation" style="object-fit:cover;width:100%" srcSet="https://media.x.ai/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,onerror=redirect,width=640,f=auto/v1/docs/grok-bot-wallpaper-light-blue-7x6-704072c3.webp 640w,

class="hgw-box"><dt class="text-primary text-sm leading-6 font-medium">App sign-ins</dt><dd class="text-primary/70 text-sm leading-6 text-pretty">They stay on Cursor&#x27;s servers. Bots use your apps without ever getting them.</dd></div><div class="hgw-box"><dt class="text-primary text-sm leading-6 font-medium">Vault</dt><dd class="text-primary/70 text-sm leading-6 text-pretty">Saved logins and cards fill into the page without your Bot seeing them.</dd></div></dl></figure><p>Your Bots aren&#x27;t separated from each other. Your other Bots are now signed in to
the conference site too, and they can use the work card in Vault. Sign out of
services a Bot no longer needs, and delete sensitive files when the work is
done. Enterprise teams can also set a network policy and inference hooks. See
<a href="/grok-bot/security" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Grok Bot security</a>.</p><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="your-primary-bot-and-bots-with-one-job" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#your-primary-bot-and-bots-with-one-job">Your primary Bot and Bots with one job</a></h2></span><p>Most Bots work best with one clear job, like your expenses Bot. Your
<a href="/grok-bot/bots#your-primary-bot" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">primary Bot</a> is different. It&#x27;s your main
point of contact. It checks in with you on its own and coordinates your other
Bots. You could send the conference request to your primary Bot, and it could
pass the work to your expenses Bot.</p><div data-fullscreen="none" class="not-prose my-6 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl outline-1 -outline-offset-1 outline-black/10 dark:outline-white/10"><div class="gbm-wide"><div role="group" aria-label="Your primary Bot in the sidebar, next to your expenses Bot" class="gbm-frame pb" data-camera="top-left"><span class="absolute inset-0 [&amp;_img]:size-full block dark:hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" role="presentation" style="object-fit:cover;width:100%" srcSet="https://media.x.ai/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,onerror=redirect,width=640,f=auto/v1/docs/grok-bot-wallpaper-light-violet-7x6-cb3d0b90.webp 640w,

When the same kind of request keeps coming
back with its own sources, rules, or schedule, give it its own Bot, or ask your
primary Bot to create one. A Bot with one job builds up memory for that job, so
you only explain it once.</p><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="best-practices" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#best-practices">Best practices</a></h2></span><ul>
<li>Start in your primary Bot. Give work its own Bot when it has its own sources,
schedule, or approval needs. To set up several Bots at once, start from
<a href="https://x.ai/bot/marketplace/bots/dr-eggbot-v2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">dr eggbot</a>.</li>
<li>Ask a Bot to remember rules that last. Put the details of a single task in
your message.</li>
<li>For numbers that change, like prices or budgets, ask the Bot to look them up
instead of relying on memory.</li>
<li>Connect an app for each service you use often. If a service has no app, add
its MCP server, or have
<a href="https://x.ai/bot/marketplace/bots/tinkabot" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">tinkabot</a> build one from its
API.</li>
<li>Never paste a secret into a chat. Passwords go through Vault, 1Password, or a
Secure Form. Cards go through Vault or a Secure Form. API keys go through a
secure secret card.</li>
<li>Get a task working once and
<a href="/grok-bot/skills-routines-and-automations#save-a-skill" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">save it as a skill</a>.
Then <a href="/grok-bot/skills-routines-and-automations#create-a-routine" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">create a routine</a>
that runs it on a schedule or when something happens, like a Slack message or
an email to your Bot.</li>
<li>Add specific <strong>Ask first</strong> rules for sending, publishing, and deleting. To
approve every payment, don&#x27;t save the card in Vault.</li>
<li>Treat anything on the computer as available to all your Bots.</li>
<li>In a <a href="/grok-bot/chat-and-collaboration" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">group chat</a>, make one Bot responsible
for each step.</li>
</ul><a href="https://x.ai/bot/marketplace/bots/dr-eggbot-v2" class="bg-card hover:bg-card-hover group flex rounded-2xl transition-colors duration-200 not-prose focus-visible:outline-primary group See\\n\",[\"$\",\"a\",null,{\"href\":\"/grok-bot/vault#pay-for-things\",\"children\":\"Pay for things\",\"className\":\"text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2\"}],\".\"]}]\n5d:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":\"If a task needs an API key, the Bot sends you a secure secret card. The key\\nstays hidden and out of the chat.\"}]\n5e:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":[\"Some steps need you, like single sign-on, a passkey, or a CAPTCHA the Bot can't\\nsolve. For those, the Bot hands you the computer. Choose \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Open computer\"}],\" on\\nthe request, then \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Take control\"}],\". Finish that step, and tell the Bot to\\ncontinue. See \",[\"$\",\"a\",null,{\"href\":\"/grok-bot/vault\",\"children\":\"Vault and secure sign-in\",\"className\":\"text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2\"}],\" and\\n\",[\"$\",\"a\",null,{\"href\":\"/grok-bot/computer-and-apps#connect-1password\",\"children\":\"Connect 1Password\",\"className\":\"text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2\"}],\".\"]}]\n5f:[\"$\",\"span\",null,{\"className\":\"not-prose\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"$L87\",null,{\"id\":\"4-it-asks-before-it-emails-finance\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"a\",null,{\"className\":\"not-prose\",\"href\":\"#4-it-asks-before-it-emails-finance\",\"children\":\"4. It asks before it emails finance\"}]}]}]\n60:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":\"With the pass bought, the Bot is ready to email the receipt to finance. You made\\na rule to approve emails first, so it stops and asks you.\"}]\n61:[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"data-fullscreen\":\"none\",\"className\":\"not-prose my-6 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl outline-1 -outline-offset-1 outline-black/10 dark:outline-white/10\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"className\":\"gbm-wide\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"$L90\",null,{}]}]}]\n62:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":\"Before a Bot runs a command, uses an app, or acts on its computer, Auto Review\\nchecks the action. Auto Review is on by default, and most actions go ahead on\\ntheir own. When one needs you, the Bot shows an approval card with the action\\nand its details, then waits.\"}]\n63:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":[\"You can add your own rules too. In \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Settings → General\"}],\", under \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Bot\"}],\", open\\n\",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Custom Rules\"}],\". Describe an action in plain words, like “send an email,” and\\nchoose \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Ask first\"}],\" or \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Allow automatically\"}],\". An \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Ask first\"}],\" rule always\\nstops a matching action. That's the rule that stopped this email.\"]}]\n64:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":[\"A card stopped by an \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Ask first\"}],\" rule shows \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Edit rule\"}],\", which opens your\\nCustom Rules. Other cards can show \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Always allow\"}],\", which saves a rule so\\nsimilar actions run on their own next time.\"]}]\n65:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":[\"Only your own messages count as instructions. Say the conference page had hidden\\ntext telling the Bot to email your contacts. Auto Review wouldn't treat that as\\na request from you. These checks lower the risk from harmful content, but they\\ndon't remove it. Keep \",[\"$\",\"strong\",null,{\"children\":\"Ask first\"}],\" rules on anything you can't undo. See\\n\",[\"$\",\"a\",null,{\"href\":\"/grok-bot/approvals-security-and-privacy#configure-auto-review\",\"children\":\"Configure Auto Review\",\"className\":\"text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2\"}],\".\"]}]\n66:[\"$\",\"span\",null,{\"className\":\"not-prose\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"$L87\",null,{\"id\":\"5-it-logs-the-expense-and-reports-back\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"a\",null,{\"className\":\"not-prose\",\"href\":\"#5-it-logs-the-expense-and-reports-back\",\"children\":\"5. It logs the expense and reports back\"}]}]}]\n67:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":\"Last, the Bot adds the expense to your Finance sheet in Google Drive, another\\nconnected app. Then it replies with everything it did. If you've closed your\\nlaptop by then, it keeps going and notifies you when it's done.\"}]\n68:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":\"The chat shows each step as the Bot works, from your message to its reply.\"}]\n69:[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"data-fullscreen\":\"none\",\"className\":\"not-prose my-6 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl outline-1 -outline-offset-1 outline-black/10 dark:outline-white/10\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"className\":\"gbm-wide\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"$L91\",null,{}]}]}]\n6a:[\"$\",\"span\",null,{\"className\":\"not-prose\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"$L87\",null,{\"id\":\"security\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"a\",null,{\"className\":\"not-prose\",\"href\":\"#security\",\"children\":\"Security\"}]}]}]\n6b:[\"$\",\"p\",null,{\"children\":\"Your expenses Bot did all of this as you.
